caption:
Stock market news | RBI flags broad food inflation and net dollar buyer status

RBI's latest bulletin notes that food price inflation remains broad, signalling continued pressure on consumer costs. It also recorded a net purchase of foreign dollars in September, reflecting active currency market management.
These developments highlight the central bank's focus on stabilising prices and the rupee, which can influence borrowing costs and market sentiment.
